assays.assay_description: Mice placed individually in Columbus Instruments actometers; distance traveled recorded by infrared beams for 12 h on day 20 and 1 h on day 41 of chronic dietary mycelium supplementation.

assays.assay_description: After 24 h food deprivation, mice placed in a 40×60 cm arena lined with standard bedding with a single pellet on an illuminated central platform; latency to first bite measured (max 10 min), followed by home-cage latency phase (max 5 min). Performed on days 22 and 38.

setup_restrain.evidence: each mouse was placed in the lower left corner of the arena

outcomes.summary: Mycelium-supplemented mice showed significantly shorter latency to feed in the novel arena on day 22 (anxiolytic-like), but no difference on retest at day 38.

Upon retesting on day 38, no statistically significant differences were observed (Control: 81.8±32.11 s vs. Mycelium: 88.25±19.44 s; t(18)=0.7055; p=0.48)

judge_notes: All three candidates identified the same 5 assays (LA, NSFT, SPT, FUST, TST); no merges or drops. Body weight, feed intake and body temperature are physiological and not scored.
application_type set to 'other' (dietary admixture) because 'food' is not an allowed C1 value; dosing route kept as 'food'.
Dosing schedule set to 'microdosing' because the paper explicitly frames the 42-day regimen as chronic microdosing; 0.074 mg/kg/day derived from 0.0018 mg/day at ~24.4 g body weight.
Age set to 42 days at experiment start (5 weeks at purchase + 7-day adaptation); classified adolescent.
B1 corrected to score 0 for single-measure assays (gemma gave 1 for '1' measures); FUST B1=0 since only one sniffing value is reported; FUST B5=1 (no live conspecific, urine cue only).

D1 set to 'Continuous monitoring' for LA (uninterrupted 12-h session on day 20) and SPT (uninterrupted 24-h bottle measurement) per rubric definition (>=6 h uninterrupted); this overrides the modal LA value of 1.
NSFT D5=1 and time_to_assay=1440 min: drug was delivered only via food and mice were food-deprived 24 h before each NSFT, so testing occurred >=24 h after the last intake.

Food/water restriction for LA set to not_reported (actometer contents undescribed); candidates' 'ad libitum' evidence referred to home-cage housing, not the test apparatus. NSFT/FUST water set to 'during' per rubric default for short tests without a bottle.
Room acclimation (TST, NSFT) not counted as setup habituation; stimulus pre-exposure (FUST applicator, SPT sucrose) counted as yes with medium confidence (modal).
